summary.aggregation_policy: Each requirement is counted once. Row counts are reported per requirement and are not pooled into a weighted quality score.

conclusion.statement: The benchmark supports the conclusion that CHAMEO provides broad characterization methodology, while H₂KG complements it with hydrogen-domain specificity and direct valued-parameter and individually provenance-linked result patterns.
conclusion.scope: This is a conclusive result for the frozen thirteen-requirement characterization knowledge-graph benchmark over the eight workbook-derived cases. Governance, maintainability, reasoning performance, usability, and scalability were not measured.

h2kg.query:

  FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?semanticGraph), "https://w3id.org/h2kg/examples/characterization/graph/semantic/"))
  BIND(STRAFTER(STR(?semanticGraph), "https://w3id.org/h2kg/examples/characterization/graph/semantic/") AS ?caseKey)
